as_told.title: Wall Street Journal's UFO consultant David Spergel

plain: Michels says that in 2024 his friend Karl Nell, who represented the Army on a government task force studying unidentified flying objects, wrote an opinion piece on UFOs with a former Secretary of Defense for The Wall Street Journal, and that Michels lobbied for it himself, even meeting the opinion editor, Lena Bell, at the paper's headquarters. He says the paper turned it down, and that Bell told him a man named David Spergel acts as their unofficial UFO advisor and says UFOs are all "space trash, light reflections, and temperature inversions." Michels tells it first-hand, citing his emails with the paper, as a sign that a major newspaper was leaning on one dismissive voice to keep the subject out.
